title: Electronics weekly optimized preheader win

change.control: Daily newsletter with no deliberately specified preheader snippet.
change.variant: Use a prefix and ASCII symbol to call attention to the second-most-popular story in the preheader; keep sender and subject structure consistent.

sample_size.unit: subscribers in the list used for the repeated test series; not cumulative email sends

quote: achieved a 4.9% higher open rate — a relative increase of 30% — over a newsletter with no snippet.
notes: Repeated A/B series using a 5,000-subscriber list. This is the final optimized-snippet versus no-snippet comparison; no per-arm counts or cumulative unique exposure counts are given. Also 17% higher clickthrough. Source separately describes a 4.9% higher open rate and explicitly labels 30% as the relative increase; do not substitute 4.9 for the relative lift.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
